x-e-h3-03.thinking.1: Dib u eegista xukun macluumaad cusub
x-e-h3-03.title: Isla dhacdo, cinwaano kala duwan: xukunnadu waa beddelmaan marka macluumaadku kordho
x-e-h3-03.goal: Marka macluumaadku kordho, dib u eeg xukunkaaga sida codka iyo ka tagidda cinwaanku ugu janjeeraan hal dhinac marka loo eego xaqiiqooyinka, oo sharax hal curiye Ingiriis.
x-e-h3-03.material: Maqaal ku saabsan go'aanka golaha magaalada ee kordhinta khidmadda dhigidda baabuurta agagaarka saldhigga ayaa si tallaabo-tallaabo ah loo sii daayay. Daawo haddii xukunkaagu beddelmo mar kasta oo macluumaadku kordho.
x-e-h3-03.thinking.0: Fahamka dareenka ay abuuraan doorashada erayada iyo ka tagidda
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.prompt: Cinwaanka iyo nuxurka maqaalka ayaa hal-hal loo muujiyaa. Marxalad kasta, dooro xukunka ugu habboon adigoo isticmaalaya macluumaadka ilaa hadda.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kala sooc erayada cinwaanka ee bixiya xaqiiqooyin iyo kuwa bixiya dareen.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Marka hore barbar dhig haddii macluumaadka cusub uu beddelayo xukunkaagii hore.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Cinwaan: "Council Slaps Drivers with 50 Percent Fee Hike Near Station" (slap: in lagu dhufto gacan fidsan, hike: kordhin weyn oo qiimaha ah)
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Eray xukun sida 'slaps' ayaa lagu soo kordhiyay xaqiiqo (khidmaddu way kordhaysaa). Waqtigan waxaad fahmeysaa dareenka oo keliya.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waxay dareemaysaa inay tahay cinwaan xaqiiqooyin oo keliya sheegaya oo dareen lagu darin, sababtoo ah wuxuu leeyahay lambar (50 Percent)
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Xitaa haddii lambarku sax yahay, eray sida "slaps" ayaa abuura dareen.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waxay dareemaysaa jilicsan, sida golaha uu khidmadda si taxadar leh u kordhiyay
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: "Slaps" ma aha eray taxadar leh ama jilicsan; wuxuu maskaxda keenaa in si xun qof la dhufto.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Waxay dareemaysaa sida darawalladu si aan caddaalad ahayn loo ciqaabayo
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: "Slaps" iyo "hike" waxay abuuraan dareen ka dhigaya darawalladu inay u muuqdaan dhibanayaal.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Faqradii ugu horreysay ee maqaalka: Khidmadda baabuurta saacaddii waxay ka kor u kacdaa 1,000 won ilaa 1,500 won, kordhintii ugu horreysay muddo 12 sano ah. Codbixinta golaha waxay ahayd 5 ilaa 4.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Waa maxay qiimeynta ugu habboon ee 'a 50 percent fee hike' iyo 'slaps' ee cinwaanka?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Lambarku waa sax. Laakiin erayga 'slaps' iyo ka tagidda xaaladda ah khidmaddu ma kordhin 12 sano ayaa dareenka u janjeeriyay hal dhinac.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Maadaama lambarku sax yahay, cinwaankani waa cinwaan dhexdhexaad ah oo xaqiiqooyin oo keliya sheegaya.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Xitaa haddii lambarku sax yahay, dareenku wuu beddelmi karaa iyadoo ku xiran doorashada erayada iyo ka tagidda.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Lambarku waa sax, laakiin erayga "slaps" iyo ka tagidda "first in 12 years" waxay abuuraan dareen hal dhinac ah.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kani waa xukun lagu sameeyay hubinta xaqiiqooyinka iyo qiimeynta codka iyo ka tagidda si gooni ah.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Lambarka laftigiisu waa khalad, sidaas darteed cinwaanku waa been, loona baahnayn in laga hadlo eexasho.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kororka ka bilaabma 1,000 ilaa 1,500 runtii waa 50 percent. Tani waa waxa dhaca marka aad wax been ku sheegto adigoon hubin lambarka.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Wax yar kadib maqaalka: Khidmadaha la kordhiyay waxaa loo isticmaali doonaa laba waddo bas oo cusub. Magaalada deriska ahi waxay qaadaa 2,000 won saacaddii. Afarta xubnood ee golaha ee ka codeeyay diidmo waxay yidhaahdeen kororku aad buu u weyn yahay.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Marka loo eego xaqiiqooyinka la ogyahay ilaa hadda, cinwaankee cusub ayaa ugu cadaalad badan?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Cinwaan cadaalad ah wuxuu isticmaalaa xaqiiqooyin la xaqiijiyay oo keliya wuxuuna ka tagayaa erayada xukunka. Cinwaanno badan oo caynkaas ah ayaa suurtagal ah, dareenkuna wuu yara kala duwan yahay iyadoo ku xiran xaqiiqooyinka aad dooratid. Jirku wuxuu daryeelaa nuxurka inta kale.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Erayga xukunka "wisely" wuxuu abuuraa dareen wanaagsan, aragtiyaha ka soo horjeedana waa laga tagay.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wuxuu ka kooban yahay xaqiiqooyin la xaqiijiyay oo keliya (codbixinta, xaddiga) wuxuuna ka tagayaa erayada xukunka.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: 'Furious' wuxuu abuuraa oo ku lifaaqaa dareen aan maqaalka lagu xaqiijin.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wuxuu isticmaalaa xaqiiqooyin la xaqiijiyay oo keliya mana laha eray xukun. Natiijada codbixinta iyo aragtiyaha ka soo horjeedda waa laga tagay, laakiin waa doorasho la aqbali karo cinwaan.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.info: Faallo akhriste: "Every headline leaves something out, so there is no such thing as a fair headline."
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.ask: Waa maxay jawaabta ugu habboon ee faallooyinkan?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.after: Ka tagiddu lama baaqsan karo. Sidaas darteed halkii 'eex ama aan eex ahayn,' waxay ka faa'iido badan tahay in la barbar dhigo 'doorasho kee ayaa ugu janjeedha hal dhinac.'
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Qayb ahaan run. Ka tagidda lama baaqsan karo, laakiin doorashooyin qaar ayaa ugu janjeedha hal dhinac.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Kani waa xukun aqoonsanaya labadaba in ka tagiddu aan la baaqsan karin iyo in ay jiraan farqiyo darajo ah.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Run. Sidaas darteed cinwaan kasta waa eex isla darajo ah.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.r.b: "Everything omits, so everything is the same" waa gabagabo ka daalatay barbar dhigidda.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Been. Haddii aad qorto xaqiiqooyin sida tirooyin iyo taariikho oo keliya, cinwaanku waxba ma ka tago.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Dooridda xaqiiqooyinka lagu darayo laftigeedu waa doorasho, sidaas darteed ka tagidda ayaa dhalata.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.reflect: Marka aad aragtay cinwaankii ugu horreeyay oo keliya, waxaad fahmi kartay dareenka oo keliya, kadib hubinta xaqiiqooyinka-na waxaad si gooni ah u qiimeyn kartay tirooyinka iyo codka. Marka macluumaad cusub yimaado, waxaad dib u eegtaa xukunka 'cinwaankani waa eex' adigoo u kala qaybinaya tirooyin, erayo, iyo ka tagid.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.prompt: Dooro hal eray ama ka tagid ka dhigaya cinwaankii ugu horreeyay (Council Slaps Drivers ...) inuu u muuqdo mid hal dhinac u janjeedha, oo Ingiriis ku sharax.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dooro hal eray oo cinwaanka ah oo bixiya dareen.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hal weedh ku qor sida dareenka akhristuhu u beddelmi lahaa haddii erayga la tuuro.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxday in erayga ama ka tagidda aad doortay ay beddesho 'dareenka,' ma aha xaqiiqooyinka?
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Haddii aad doortay ka tagid, ma qortay si gaar ah waxa laga tagay?
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu tilmaamayaa labadaba erayga iyo ka tagidda.

x-e-h3-09.material: Qaxwadii aad ka dalbatay makhaayad weli ma imaan 40 daqiiqo ka dib. Waxaad ku sii socotaa inaad la hadasho shaqaalaha.
x-e-h3-09.thinking.0: Qiimeynta edebta iyo caddaynta si wada jir ah
x-e-h3-09.thinking.1: Ka-fiirsashada macnaha qarsoon ee hadallada aan toos ahayn

x-e-h3-09.prereq.1: Khibrad dalabka makhaayad Ingiriisi lagu sameeyay
x-e-h3-09.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan hadallada aad shaqaalaha ku odhan lahayd ee edeb leh oo sidoo kale si cad u gudbinaya waxa aad rabto inay sameeyaan.
x-e-h3-09.s.s1.hint.0: Maskax ku hay shaqaalaha oo maqlaya hadal kasta, oo hal sadar u qor sida shaqaaluhu uga jawaabi lahaa.
x-e-h3-09.s.s1.hint.1: Hay hadallada u oggolaanaya shaqaalaha inay ogaadaan waxa ay sameeyaan kadib marka ay maqlaan oo keliya.
x-e-h3-09.s.s1.r.a: Waa cad yahay laakiin ma aha mid aad u edeb badan, sidaa darteed shaqaaluhu waxay uga jawaabi karaan si difaac ah.
x-e-h3-09.s.s1.r.b: Wuxuu si cad oo edeb leh u gudbiyaa xaaladda iyo codsiga.
x-e-h3-09.s.s1.r.c: Isku dayga ah in la noqdo mid edeb badan, codsigii wuu cirroobay. Shaqaaluhu waxay u malayn karaan inaan dhibaato dhab ah jirin.
x-e-h3-09.s.s1.r.d: Ma gudbiyo cabashada gabi ahaanba, sidaa darteed shaqaaluhu sabab ay ficil ku qaadaan ma haystaan.
x-e-h3-09.s.s1.r.e: Waxay muujisaa raali-galin iyadoo cadaynaysa waxa aad ka codsanayso inay sameeyaan.
x-e-h3-09.s.s1.explain: b iyo e waa edeb leh iyadoo xaaladda (dalbay 40 daqiiqo ka hor) iyo codsiga (fadlan hubi) labadaba la cadaynayo. a waxay ka maqan tahay edeb, c waxay ka maqan tahay caddayn, d na waxay ka maqan tahay codsi.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.prompt: Marka la weydiiyay shaqaale makhaayad "Could you make my coffee right now?", shaqaaluhu wuxuu ku jawaabay, "I'm afraid the machine is being cleaned until three." Waa maxay wax-ka-qaadista ugu macquulsan ee jawaabtan laga qaadi karo?
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.hint.0: Eeg sida macluumaadka jawaabta (mashiinka la nadiifinayo, ilaa saddexda) ugu xidhan yahay codsiga hadda.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.hint.1: Kala saar waxa shaqaaluhu yiri iyo waxa aad ku dartay sida mala-awaal.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.r.a: Waxay u akhriday "hadda maya" sida "waqti kasta maya".
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.r.b: Shaqaalaha weligood ma yidhaahdeen inay samayn doonaan saddex. Wuxuu akhriyay ballan aan la hadlin.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.r.c: Wuxuu akhriyay labadaba macnaha hoose ee ah hadda way adag tahay, iyo suurtagalnimada ah in diidmadu aysan weligeed ahayn.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.explain: Shaqaaluhu wuxuu bixiyay sababta aan hadda suurtagal u ahayn oo keliya. Waxa xiga ee la sameeyo waa in si edeb leh mar kale loo weydiiyo waqti suurtagal ah.
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.prompt: Sharax 1-2 weedhood Ingiriisi ah sababta doorashada c ee su'aasha 1 u daciif tahay in kasta oo ay u muuqato edeb leh.
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.hint.0: Akhri c oo eeg haddii shaqaaluhu heli karaan wax ay u baahan yihiin inay sameeyaan.
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.hint.1: Eeg sida erayada 'maybe,' 'possibly,' iyo 'probably nothing' u beddelaan xoogga codsiga.
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Sharaxaaddaadu ma tidhaahdaa 'codsigu ma gaadho' halkii ay odhan lahayd 'edebku waa dhibaatada'?
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sawirtay waxa aad sameyn doonto haddii aad weedhdaas ka maqasho sidii shaqaale?
